# Growvidence

> Don't just learn. Prove your progress.

Growvidence is a proposed evidence-based skill tracker for IT beginners, students and self-taught learners.

## Product principles

- Task completion is activity, not proof of competency.
- Evidence connects practice, artifacts, independent demonstration and feedback.
- AI assistance should be disclosed clearly.
- The MVP is planned as a static, local-first GitHub Pages application.

## Current status

The project is in its foundation phase. The public homepage explains the product concept; learner workspace features are not yet implemented.
